title: Yellow Crunchy Chinese Chinese Leaf Stir Fry
description: A herbal and crunchy Chinese dish featuring Chinese leaf, perfect for a date night, and Whole30 friendly. This recipe combines the freshness of Chinese leaf with the savory flavor of soy sauce and the crunch of toasted almonds.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the Chinese leaf and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes or until it starts to wilt.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and 1 tablespoon of water.
Pour the soy sauce mixture into the skillet and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the toasted almonds and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Deglaze the skillet with 1 tablespoon of water and stir-fry for 1 minute.
